note: The ketiv 'e'ebod "I will not serve" (LXX, Vulgate) fits the broken yoke; the qere 'e'ebor "I will not transgress" (KJV) makes Israel promise obedience.
Hebrew radnu (from rud "roam") means "we roam free"; the KJV derived it from radah "rule".
